  SELECT session, path
  FROM (
    SELECT session, path, stamp,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) as rn

combined AS (
  SELECT session, path FROM session_landing
  UNION

SELECT path, COUNT(*) as session_count

WITH landing_pages AS (
    -- First visit per session (earliest timestamp)
    SELECT session, path
    FROM (
        SELECT stamp, session, path,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
        FROM activity_log
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
exit_pages AS (
    -- Last visit per session (latest timestamp)
    SELECT session, path
    FROM (
        SELECT stamp, session, path,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) as rn
        FROM activity_log
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) as session_count
FROM (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing_pages
    UNION ALL
    SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY session_count DESC
</parameter>
